balls.text: another boundary as Ellis finishes with a short ball and Chahar finishes with a pull that he may not have middled, but got enough on to send it wide of short fine leg. Ellis is livid with himself while Chahar punches the air

pretty wide outside off, swinging away too and he lets it go. Not called a wide and Chahar calls for a review. Let's look at the replays - Chahar started with a stance way outside off and the wide line moves with that, and even though Chahar moved back to the normal stance, the ball was within the moved wide line. Decision upheld
113.1kmh, doesn't turn out badly as Raju pulls the short and slow ball square for one
slams the full delivery wide of cover this time, and they've run across. Should Chahar have farmed the strike?
into the stands! It's short, it's slow, it's pulled away with watchful eyes and he has middled that to send it sailing over deep midwicket
slow and wide yorker, Chahar gets an inside edge off the big swing past the stumps and they scamper back for the second

skied down the ground and the captain settles under it, pouches it easily. Khaleel ends his quota with his third strike, makes it 3 for 29. Boult backed away for a big hit but he didn't get much on that slower ball that was short, sent it quite high down the ground which Gaikwad settled under easily
some width outside off but not much pace, cuts it away for one with some power
Boult in the action now, he scythes this in the air over point and there's a fielder in the deep. So only one
angling in, Chahar swats it away to long-on and Jadeja teases them by leaving the ball in front of him. The crowd loves it

lands this one next to the sight screen! Deepak Chahar asks for a promotion in the batting order. This is some clean hitting from Chahar. Gets one in the slot outside off and this time Chahar doesn't need to move, lofts it straight down over long-off
flays it over the covers and Deepak Chahar loves that! He made room early, manufactured room for the slower ball outside off and sent it flying over the covers

135.2kmh, this ain't a slower one as Santner misses this one on the stumps, appeal for lbw and CSK are interested in this. Is it high? Because it was a short of length ball. They review the not out decision. No bat there, and there you go - ball-tracking says that's hitting top of middle! Excellent review
really slow back of length on off, he swivels on the back foot to swat it to leg but he's beaten by pace. Only a leg bye
slower ball on off which Chahar picks, he rolls his wrists over that to flick to leg and he wants two. A slightly wayward throw otherwise Chahar was struggling
no room at all, on length on middle and he steers it towards cover for one
on length on middle and leg, he defends it back this time
over mid-off for four! After all those nudges and pushes, Santner unleashes a classy straight drive lofted over mid-off with a wonderful follow through for a one-bounce four
lunges forward and very respectfully he blocks this ball back in the death overs to make it a dot ball
the googly from outside off, Chahar pokes and misses. He nearly left that one as the bat was a long way inside
punched into the covers off the back foot and they get one more
lunges forward to get some bat towards point and they run across for one quickly
full and wide, driven along the ground but straight to cover

bowled around his legs and Naman Dhir can barely believe it! Fourth wicket for Noor Ahmad and what a way to get that fourth. Pitches it just outside leg, Dhir goes for the sweep, misses the sweep, and it's the wrong'un that goes on to rattle leg stump. Dhir looks back at the stumps and then towards the bowler. Did that really happen?
slower one on leg, he shuffles to off and nudges it fine to the fielder in the circle for one
drives the fuller ball back, it deflects off Ellis to off and they go across for one
takes the pace off now for the short ball well outside off and it's called a wide this time for the line
quick tenth bal lon the stumps, no room to work with and he pushes it down to mid-off
more towards good length now on off and he taps the legcutter to leg for one
short ball outside off, closer to the stumps and he pulls that away square for two more
135.2kmh, short of length outside off which Dhir taps late towards short third where the fielder gets a hand but can't hold on so they take two
looks like a carom ball to end the over on the stumps, he pushes to off for one

over the covers for four! A boundary off the bat for the first time since the first ball of ninth over, make that 39 balls. He made room early and lofted that over cover to use that massive gap. Smart stuff
slow on the stumps, he waits and pushes through cover for one
on length on middle, tucked to leg again for one more
shuffles to off, Ashwin follows him and he uses soft hands to help it to leg for two quick runs
short ball from wide of the crease and he pushes through the covers for one
flat on middle and leg, some turn and tucked to midwicket for one more
just a bit short and Dhir swats it away to long-on for one
a bit towards the pads now and nudged square for one
stays still and blocks the length ball right back
watches the length ball carefully and defends
outside off and he cuts the ball away for one

trapped right in front and given straightaway! Another one bites the dust and this is a big wicket. That is plumb unless Tilak has edged it, and he has reviewed it. UltraEdge on the screen now, flat line as ball passes the bat, and ball-tracking is taking time. Here it is, turning in from outside off, impact in line, going on to hit middle and that's three reds!
turning from leg to middle, easily nudged to leg for one
the pressure mounts and Minz departs. He goes downtown for the wrong'un, doesn't get much distance on that and Jadeja will take those 10 times out of 10 at long-off
on middle, heaves against it on the leg side and misses again
slammed over the covers, could be a one bounce four but the guy called Ravindra Jadeja does excellent work in the deep wide of long-off to keep this to two. Excellent work
fuller outside off, Minz goes down on a knee for a powerful shot but miscues that down the ground for one
starts with a wide, another extra, as Minz swings big on the leg side and misses
aims to sweep the ball on leg, he also misses and there's no time for a leg bye either as Tilak is sent back by Minz
backs away and smacks the shorter ball to off but he finds cover
on middle and leg again, he nudges towards midwicket for one
almost chips it back, but he lobs it to Ashwin's left off the back foot
94.4kmh, towards the pads, Minz wans to sweep it away but misses
almost a wide yorker which Tilak reaches out for to steer square of the wicket and they come back for the second quickly, also helped by a wayward throw
keeps turning them down leg, this one goes past the pads for a wide
going well down leg again and he helps it along to leg for his first runs in IPL
turns into him, he stays back and is beaten. Takes the ball on the pads but going well down leg

age 43 but reflexes of a 23-year old! Dhoni has whipped the bails off in a jiffy like he's been doing that for 30 years. He probably has. Noor turns this one away from SKY, he ventures out of the crease to drive down the ground and doesn't get close at all, and Dhoni takes the bails off in a flash. Easy decision for the third umpire
straighter line this time, not much turn and Tilak works it off the back foot to leg, calls for two but have to settled for one
that turns away sharply and beats everybody! Outside off, Tilak swings against the turn, Dhoni does't pick it either and it's turned away for four byes
Flatter ball on middle leg, pushed to long-off

Ashwin holds his action midway... and misses a caught and bowled. Leapt to the right, went with high hands. Had to reach out, clasped but the ball went through. Was a full carrom ball to which SKY made room and tried to flick. Spooned it. Went at a slow pace, just too wide
Makes room and flicks the slightly short ball that was following him, through wide mid-on
Swept off a length, played well in front of the body. From middle stump. Not off the middle, but goes safely to deep square leg
Wide release. Length ball on middle and leg, 91ks, Tilak clears the front leg and pulls to long-on
Carrom ball on a length finishes on leg, no turn. 89ks. Flicked to long-on
A bit of spin away off length, SKY seemed to be a touch early on the bunt to long-on. A touch uppish but it rolls safely to the bowler's left
Similar ball, this time it's in line with leg stump. Tilak's taking an off-stump guard, so he's inside the line as he flicks it through backward square leg
Down leg, on a length, pulled along backward square leg
Length on fifth, driven to cover.
Makes room and gets followed by a full ball on leg, driven to cover point
Slog swept, deep midwicket in play? Nah. Clears him easy. Was a length ball on fourth turned into a full one with a big forward stride and lunge
Another two, this time to the left of deep point. Was a wide, fullish ball that was cut with a flashy follow-through
Full on leg, the back leg lifts up as the ball it whipped between long-on and deep midwicket
Length on leg, more of a skiddy ball. 96ks. Flicked off the back foot to deep midwicket
Top edges a sweep to a full ball on fifth, 92ks. Khaleel runs in from deep-backward square leg, can't reach it.
Miscued cut again, better connection this time. On a couple of bounces to point
Rear up off a length, SKY goes for the cut but there is no room. His shoulder goes back with his elbows buckling, ball goes off the sticker to short third
Wide and short, sharp angle away. Let go. 92ks
Wide and full, the angle kept taking it away. Tilak planted his back foot inside the crease while trying to flash it square over the off side. Missed it and managed to keep the toe inside.
Length around off, punched to the bowler

Curran misjudges at long-off, he was in a few metres from the boundary. Then he had to go back fell knee-first into the grass as the ball sailed over him. Woulda been catchable height had he been at the ropes.
100ks full ball on fourth looked slower than it was, driven to cover
Length on middle stump, flicked through midwicket
Full ball is down leg, SKY tries flicking with all stumps exposed. Misses, gets hit on the pad
140ks bouncer beats the pull/hook. Tilak was hurried, not sure if he wanted to go square or fine. Line was just outside off, so he would have had to drag it.
Wide... and no-ball, quite the double-whammy. Foot was on the line but nothing behind, no field change too. Was a very wide length ball, might've slipped off the hand. Let go
Fullish ball on middle and leg, flicked to midwicket
Back of lengther at 135ks surprises SKY, might've bounced more than he expected. Line was right at the body. SKY's upper-body wound back and the hands fended forward, gets it safely to point

Overpitched on the pads, flick's been launched over square leg. Weight's on the front foot, back foot twirls forward late but his body's mostly still while the hands go up to down to back up in a flurry
Fullish length ball lands around leg and goes at the stumps, clipped to midwicket
Full on fourth, punched sweetly to mid-off
Yowza, one ups the cut with a skilful reverse sweep. Over short third, four. A bit Bazball-y. Stance shifted fully, so yeah, it was likely a pre-meditated shot. Picked it off the stumps too.
Whoa, that's some intent. Tilak comes in with MI three down in the powerplay, makes a bit of room, keeps the back foot in the crease and carves the length ball over point.

Jacks holes out to extra cover, big smile on Ashwin's face as he high-fives Dhoni. Was a carrom ball that seemed to swing in, finished around top of middle. Jacks tried a powerplay shot, just lift it over the infield while in the crease. Playing on the up didn't work out. Off the bottom of the bat, Dube hobbles back a couple of steps and takes a simple catch.
All three stumps visible as SKY waits for the length ball on his pads to arrive, flicked to midwicket
Drift in but it's a step-hit for SKY. Fourth-stump 90ks full ball is driven, lofted off drive, well over and to the left of mid-off
Length on leg, flicked to long-on
On a back of length again, top of middle, worked back to the bowler
Pulled this time, it was coming. Ellis' pace-on short balls are rising just over stump height. This was around top of SKY's right leg, he stood still and heaved across. Got it through midwicket
Back of length on middle and off, flicked off the back foot to the right of mid-on
Quick single to mid-off's left. Shortish again, fourth-stump line, more skiddy stuff. SKY has time to wait before rocking back and punching with a mostly horizontal bat
Shortish ball lands around off and skids to top of middle, flicked off the back foot through midwicket
Slower one to start. Length ball on top of middle and off, flicked to deep square leg
Heart of a length, fourth-stump line, 134ks, guided to point with a defensive vertical bat
Length on fourth, open-faced block towards point
Length on top of middle, defended to the bowler

He almost falls like Rohit, ball half-volleys to midwicket. The fielder - Dube - was lunging out forward while having his feet still on the ground. Didn't carry. Was a 134ks fullish ball on middle stump that was flicked with a flourish. Ball went right off the bottom of the bat. Didn't hold back the power, so the off stump was actually floored.

Nails the cut one ball, chops on next. High-fives everywhere for Khaleel, Rickelton played attractive shots but his innings is just a cameo. This was similar to the last ball, maybe a touch fuller and wider. Rickelton went for another cut, under-edged it to off stump on the bounce.
Slapped off the top of the bounce, ball races through cover. Ball was a touch back of length, line maybe fifth stump at best, Rickelton's stillness made it look wider than it was

Slot ball, it's fullish but there's no swing. It's a lofted flick essentially, the bat face semi-closed and both back-lift and follow-through were big. Not middled but that cleared the infield easy and went to the wide long-on fence
Similar length, in the channel, flicked off the back foot to long-on. Even bounce again, Rickelton's trusting it
Touch back of a length on leg, flicked off the back foot to midwicket

Test-quality straight punch, no weight transfer but that had the optics of a back-foot shot. Ball was on a fuller side of length, around top of middle and off, Rickelton waited till it came near him and showed it the full face. Checked shot past the bowler
Fullish on off, this seemed to move away. Pushed off the front foot to mid-off

Flicked from middle stump, this is off the back foot and along the ground. Four through midwicket. Was a length ball that angled in, moved a touch off the seam too. Inward movement, played from within the crease
Bad ball to finish. Down leg and it's helped through square leg with a flick
That's more like a wicket-taking ball. Three-quarter length, landed around off and went through fourth stump. Jacks tried to defend straight, played the line and got beaten

Softie! Taken at midwicket! Rohit flicked the 139ks length ball just in front of the body. Wasn't an aggressive shot. Line was middle-stumpish, so the shot was on. There was no swing either, the bat face didn't really close. So, Rohit might have wanted to hit that straight. Ended up lobbing it to Dube.
Back of a length this time, at the stumps, worked back to the bowler
Goes away with the angle to beat bat. No swing, good-length ball lands around off and goest through fifth. Rohit reaches out for the push to cover before pulling the vertical bat back
Leg-stump length ball to start. On the pads, beats the flick and pops nearby. The crowd roar after the ball, early energy from them is hight
Ravindra does a Dhoni and he finishes it off in style!
goes back again to cover the stumps and Naman Dhir does well to not pitch it up. It's short and quick, forcing Dhoni to work it towards long-on but a dive from midwicket to his left saves the one
flat and turning in from outside off, he goes. back to help it to leg

a horrible mix up and CSK lose one more! this was flicked to midwicket and Jadeja went for it, Ravindra said no but Jadeja came a long way down and seeing that Ravindra ventured out too, almost crossing each other. The bails are taken off at the keeper's end, both batters almost face to face halfway down the pitch but it's confirmed they didn't cross and Jadeja is gone
tries the reverse sweep again, middles it too but finds short third
full and slow on middle, pushes it back gently
Jadeja reverse paddles that one fine on the off side and they get two quick runs

smoked over long-on this time, what a shot from Ravindra! Hardly pitched up but Ravindra charges down again, takes it on the full and absolutely smashes that on the leg side. And that could be the game
he comes down, Puthur replies with a short and quick one and Jadeja taps it to off for one
sweeps with hard hands over the square leg umpire for one more
into the stands that's a sea of yellow! Ravindra dances down, makes it a low full toss on the leg side and sends that sailing over the midwicket boundary to reach his half-century
way outside leg now and flicked away nicely for one
legbreak on middle and leg, Ravindra lunges forward and chips it back. Could have been a catch but hardly carried

137.7kmh, pace on the ball and width this time for the short of length ball and he dabs it late to deep third for one. He wanted a second too and turns around, but he's sent back while the ball was thrown to the keeper's end so no damage done for CSK
short ball, quite slow and Ravindra pulls it away with some power for one. That's one for the over

run out chance and Jadeja survives! Pulls to midwicket half-heartedly, takes off for the single and takes on the fielder who can only see one stump and goes for it but misses. Touch and go if he had hit
he bangs it in short while taking the pace off, Jadeja pulls and they come back for a second after Vignesh puts in a dive at deep square leg to save the boundary
there comes the boundary and it's from Ravindra Jadeja! Short and wide, swinging away too and all he had to do was steer it late wide of short third with decent timing and he does that perfectly
short of length on off and Ravindra lofts that over midwicket for just one
backs away just a bit and manages to cut the ball for one somehow
Jadeja goes down again, another sweep for a single but this is a quick one as fine leg is in the circle
on leg from wide of the crease, flicked away for one
well outside off and Jadeja reaches out for another sweep for one
in the air as he mistimes that drive and it balloons towards long-off but falls halfway before him
pushes the length ball from outside off to long-off uppishly. A single
Jadeja takes out the sweep now with fine leg deep and he gets one after fetching the ball from middle stump
uses hard hands to whip the fullish ball to leg, gets one
pushed straight back, Jacks dives to his left and gets a hand too but can't save the single
lunges forward this time and pushes the length ball from middle to mid-on

loud appeal for lbw first ball turned down, but looks like it either pitched outside leg or was going down leg. MI seniors get together and SKY asks for a review. Seems desperate to me, to be honest, but these are desperate times. Firstly, nothing on UltraEdge so no bat. It's pitched in line on leg but it's going down leg, so MI lose a review
swings and misses, loses his off stump! Straight on off stump, no tricks off the hand or the pitch, and Curran swings wildly and misses it completely. A scratchy little innings comes to an end
90.5kmh, angling in from off to leg, Curran goes back dangerously and works it square for one
just short of length outside off, punches off the back foot but finds cover
shorter on the pads and he helps it square for one more
84.9kmh, slower and on the pads, flicks it square for one easily
short and flat on off, cut straight to cover
starts like Jacks with a full one on leg and he flicks it down to long-on for one
92.9kmh, straighter but still quite full and it's on-driven against the turn for one to end the over
cuts from outside off but finds the fielder at point. Third dot of the over
Ravindra takes a step towards off to flick this one against the turn to deep midwicket. One more
works this one down to long-on this time for one
almost the same line and length, same shot to the same fielder again
full on the pads, flicked to midwicket
full on the pads and it's flicked late to short fine leg. No run there
keeps low after turning away from outside off, pulled down to long-on

that's the third wicket for Vignesh Puthur! Is he taking down CSK single-handedly? That was a tricky catch, taken nicely in the end after it looked like Chahar misjudged it in the deep. Hooda got under the ball nicely with a big sweep, but he played it high from bottom up and Chahar was a few yards inside the boundary, putting in a dive in the end to get both hands to it
half an appeal for lbw as Hooda misses the sweep from well outside off. Struck outside off most probably
he pulls the length shorter and Ravindra pulls it to deep square leg for one
he marches down and lofts that handsomely down the ground before it can turn, getting nicely under the ball for a clean six. The first boundary off Vignesh tonight
on leg again, this time worked down to long-on for one
flatter and quicker on leg to Ravindra, he defends it back
slow towards middle, he taps towards point with soft hands and they want one, but nearly bang into each other before completing the single
rocks back for the shorter ball and pulls it down to long-on for one
sharp turn for the length ball towards leg as Ravindra backs away and is surprised by the turn, ends up defending it back
from wide of the crease towards leg and swept away over square leg for one
Full on leg, flicked to midwicket
Low fully down leg. Ball might've slipped out of the hand. Paddle swept to short fine

Vignesh has two caught down at the straight boundary. This was brave. Bowled at just 80ks despite Dube looking for boundary hits previously. Was a fullish ball at the stumps, Dube took a forward stride and launched a straight drive, gets caught close to the ropes. Another big hug from the skipper
Turns in sharply, goes past the under-edge as Dube heaves across the line. MI ask for a referral, the square-leg ump denies it. Was a wide, loopy stock ball on a length that didn't bounce much.
Looped nicely, 78ks, fullish ball on fourth, Ravindra was enticed, went for the slog sweep. Clothed it along the ground to deep square leg
Fullish ball is well down leg, Ravindra gets on one knee and sweeps it fine

Dube sinks his teeth into it. Not a short ball, was length only but it sat up, picked off the stumps with a pull. Sails flat over midwicket. Stable base and high hand speed, signs of Dube looking good
Length on leg, clipped through square leg
Length on leg, flicked off the back foot to long-on. 94ks
Fullish on middle, made to look like it was down leg by Ravindra as he shuffled across. Shovels a sweep through fine leg
Length on middle and leg, punched to long-on. 92ks, no spin, came off the pitch nicely too
Fullish ball is worked back to the bowler
Fullish ball down leg, 87ks, beats the glance and goes fine. Stopped in the deep. An MI player asks if that came off the bat, no review taken
Length on leg, flicked to long leg

Maiden wicket? Yep, taken close to the straight boundary. Big hug from SKY to Vignesh. Ball was in the slot, fullis around off, there for the step-hit. Ruturaj went for the lofted straight drive, looked to have gotten it off the bottom of the bat.
Ball starts similarly but spins in late. Ruturaj is deep in the crease and outside off, cuts it nicely to point
Cut with the angle, deep point runs to the left to cut it off. Was a length ball on fifth, was just a horizontal-bat caress from Gaikwad
Slightly quick through the air. Length ball on leg, flicked through the leg side
Good start. Length on off, no spin, flicked through midwicket

Ruturaj brings up a 22-ball fifty, his fastest in the IPL, to kick off the season. Raises his bat and points to the balcony. It's a statement innings alright. Was a fullish ball on fourth, 89ks, flicked to short fine leg's left
Fullish length ball on leg, flicked to deep midwicket
Yorker on fifth, jammed to deep cover
Inside out with a diagonal bat. Over cover, just clears the ropes. Jacks loops up an offbreak
Full and loopy on off, 88ks stock ball, whipped through midwicket
Ooh, a tight second run. Throw at the non-striker's is a touch wide. Was a full ball around off that was driven to the left of deep cover
With no deep square leg, the bit of shortness was a gift for Ruturaj. It was too straight too, pulled along the ground
Opens cover point this time, makes ample room to a stock ball on middle stump. Fullish ball is driven over the infielder. Not a bad ball, Santner just can't settle in, not being afforded a chance
Shapes to do the same thing, the left leg slides but comes back, pulls it to short fine
Makes room and wallops a pull over midwicket. Not that short, just over stump-height, Ruturaj got his left leg well out of line and swung through the hips. 71-metre hit
Beaten on the pull. Was a length ball around leg that spun away a touch, got good bounce. Hit on the body
Full down leg, 88ks, flicked to short fine leg
Length on fifth, 134ks, open-faced punch takes it to deep-backward point
Back of length on leg, flicked off the back foot to the right of midwicket. Stopped with a dive
Wide on a length, late cut again. This is withoug the power. To deep-backward point

This is dragged down and even wider, sits up again. Ruturaj waits for the ball to get next to him and belts another cut, this was a bit more aerial and in the gap through point. No chance for deep-backward point who was in place
Not much width on that length ball but it sits up and is cut through backward point
Back of length, 131ks, on top of off. Delivered from slightly wide of the crease, Raju stepped towards the middle in follow-through too. Looks a touch wrong-footed almost. Pulled to deep square leg
Wide down leg, fullish ball goes past the flick

Shoots low, beats bat, luckily for Ruturaj it's not at the stumps. 136ks length ball on fourth stump, the batter's weight wasn't forward but tried - in a last-ditch effort - to try and jam it. Couldn't.
Some Test stuff. Fullish on fourth, defended to cover

Short ball, picked early, deposited over the ropes at midwicket. Ball was at the stumps, around top-of-shoulder height. Not that bad a ball, just that Gaikwad had ample time and connected nicely. 70-metre hit
Short fine in play again, Vignesh half-stops it with a dive. Deep-backward square stops it. Was a back of lengther on the pads, flicked off the back foot
Full ball swings in but the starting line was on the pads. Ravindra was able to help it along with a leg glance. A touch uppish but well to the right of short fine
Back of length on off, 135ks, might have been a bit of movement in off the pitch, pulled to midwicket.
Length on top of middle, flicked through deep square leg
Slower one is wide. Fullish too. Sits up for Gaikwad to cut to deep point
Fullish ball on off, flicked to midwicket
Tilak saves two, runs to the right and dives full length at the deep-fine-leg boundary. Was a length ball that was leg glanced
And Ruturaj dances late, turns a three-quarter-length ball into a full one. It's a firm drive through cover again
Neat cover drive. He took a big stride across, there's a flourish too but an absolutely still base as he made contact. Outfield's rapid
Length on top of middle, defended to point
The length ball angles away sharply, finishes wide. Cut to deep point

Bouncer. Gloved to the keeper. Chahar is animated with his celebration. Just 130ks but that looked quicker, angling in at the batter's left shoulder, he swivelled and tried to help it fine. Looked like he was done for pace. Surprise change of length hand MI their first.
Worked off the back foot through square leg
Width offered and that's flashed over backward point. Ravindra took a step forward, was on one knee and his weight was going forward. Was actually a shortish ball
Full down leg, glanced to deep fine. 130ks
Looked like a cutter. Cuts Ravindra in half too. Was a length ball that landed around fifth and spun in a bit, Ravindra went for the straight drive but was beaten by the lack of pace and the line.
Similar to the second ball, sans the swing. Ravindra shapes to cut, underedges it into the pitch in front
Fullish ball doesn't swing, goes down leg. Past the flick, to the keeper. Boult might've been looking for the magic ball
Swing in but it's overpitched, finishes on middle stump punched into the pitch. Ball bounces high and to the left of the bowler
Under-edges a cut to forward point. Was a wide ball on a length
This shaped away. Starting line is fifth stump, length is three-quarters. Left alone
Leg--stump length ball goes straight on, flicked through midwicket. Along the ground, two taken
